City Spare Space

In collaboration with reputable businesses, City Spare Space offers luggage storage solutions to its customers by leveraging the physical spaces of these establishments through a web app booking interface.

iOS & Android app designBrandUI/UXInformation architecture

I helped City Spare Space in refining their brand and communications to enhance their business's user experience, visual appeal, and growth. Above is an animation showcasing their three core brand logos in key colourways.

Example UI/UX improvements: branding and typography for increased visual appeal, layout optimisation for consistency of space and clarity of comprehension. Overall hierarchys overhauled to enhance user experience, pricing information and the ability to book is now more prominent. Additions such as: functionality, iconography and microcopy.

A punchy, ultra-clear flyer engages busy commuters in an effort to tackle an ongoing, physical user experience issue, of wanting to actually book at the storage location. Placed in transit hubs, we monitor the reponse to the flyer via the tracked QR code.

This simple, striking sticker is placed in the windows of the business's storage locations in an effort bridge the gap between finding the physical storage location after booking via the app.
